text:
deploy-bot: scheduling enable: `helix-7b-v3` on catalog at 2026-03-21T02:00:00Z (change window). Canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 50% over ~3h. fallback ordering switching to latency-first ladder. rollback triggers set.

deploy-bot: ops checklist:
• pin current stable `helix-7b-v2` to 100% for warmup
• enable canary 5% (region: us-west-2)
• observe telemetry 10m then promote to 25% if healthy
• auto-fallback to `helix-7b-v2` on trigger

alex: where are the exact rollback thresholds recorded?
mira: rollbacks = any of: error_rate > 3x baseline over 5m OR p95 latency > 2x baseline over 10m OR user-facing failures > 1% in canary traffic.
qa-jen: add decode errors > 0.5% as a hard fail (we flagged this in last QA run).

devops-liz: note: moving to latency-first fallback changes cold-start/kv-cache behavior. @sam can you pre-warm caches?
sam: pre-warm scheduled: `infratool warm --model=helix-7b-v2 --regions=us-west-2 --start=30m` — running now.

alex: release notes should call out that fallback ladder now uses observed p50 latency ordering; customer pins remain respected.
mira: adding telemetry dashboard: https://console.redwood/telemetry/helix-7b-v3-canary

deploy-bot: queued command:
```
/deploy enable-model --model=helix-7b-v3 --canary=5,25,50 --pin=helix-7b-v2:100 --change-window=2026-03-21T02:00Z --fallback=latency-first --rollback=err>3x,p95>2x,decode>0.5%
```

devops-liz: propose a +5m safety hold if any region shows >10% LB rejections. watching 502/504 counts.
qa-jen: smoke tests running (100 prompts) to catch immediate decode regressions.

alex: post-canary pin strategy?
mira: staged: 25% -> 50% after 1h stable -> 100% after 3h. keep v2 pinned for 6h as fallback anchor.
sam: routing will honor customer pins; we won't override them during rollout.

devops-liz: ops coverage confirmed. Manual rollback if issues. react with :rotating_light: to escalate.

alex: internal release blurb: "Enable helix-7b-v3 with latency-first fallback ladder; staged canary 5->25->50->100; pre-warm v2 KV cache; rollback thresholds set." 
mira: approved, holding manual approval until 5m before start.
deploy-bot: will post live updates during rollout and final status.
